name: AI Workstation
description: Hardware resource policy for compute-heavy local AI workloads: CPU energy preference biased toward 'performance' when on AC power or on a desktop, GPU topology reporting (compute-capable GPU presence, without requiring one), and the same evidence-based memory/storage policy as other profiles. This is resource policy only — CUDA/ROCm/PyTorch/Ollama installation is S4 scope and is not touched here. A host with no discrete GPU is still a valid 'ai' profile target (CPU-only inference). See docs/hardware/architecture.md.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2; serein hardware plan is read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
